messages.subject: having content-assist work automatically
messages.body_plain:
hey guys,

I've been using Sublime REPL recently and really like how the content
assist works automatically as I'm typing.

I know that you can get content assist to work in Eclipse by pressing
Ctrl+Space. However, I want it to appear automatically in similar fashion
to Sublime. Is this possible?

thanks!

messages.subject: Re: rmarkdown snippets
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kaiyin,

[2016-10-11] Kaiyin Zhong wrote:
> Dear list,
>
> How can I define new snippets for rmarkdown documents? For example, I
> would
> like to type `r ctrl-space` and get
>
> ```{r}
> cursor here
> ```

Such an template already exists, but not with the name r. It is usually at
the end of the proposal list.

You can also add new templates using Mylyn editor templates: On the
preference page "Wikitext [StatET]" is a link to the preference page.

Note that due to a small bug the content assist doesn't work correclty at
the end of file, just keep one or multiple linebreaks behind the cursor.

Regards,
Stephan

messages.subject: Re: having content-assist work automatically
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

[2016-10-07] Linh Mai Tran wrote:
> hey guys,
>
> I've been using Sublime REPL recently and really like how the content
> assist works automatically as I'm typing.
>
> I know that you can get content assist to work in Eclipse by pressing
> Ctrl+Space. However, I want it to appear automatically in similar fashion
> to Sublime. Is this possible?

No, at moment this is not possible.
Autoactivation of the content assistant works only after special
characters, for R code after '$'.

Regards,
Stephan
